description: A clear plastic sports drink bottle with an orange cap sits on the table in front of both hands. The left hand reaches in to grasp the bottle and tilt it slightly onto its side while the right hand moves in to grip the orange cap; the right hand twists to unscrew the cap as the left hand stabilizes the bottle, then the right hand lifts the cap off and sets it down on the tabletop while the left hand brings the now-open bottle upright.
